justification: Although the case concerns peaceful assembly and reaches genuine Article 11 merits findings, the analysis is not a single coherent merits analysis with a common outcome — it reaches opposite conclusions for different applicants (no violation for the first and third, violation for the second) — and for the second applicant the Court explicitly declines to treat the facts as settled, noting unresolved factual questions about whether he personally blocked anything and whether the police had already cleared the entrances by the time of his arrest.
